card.name: Weight and rate labels before unit brackets
card.fires_on: The word or bracket just before a unit in a dosing formula or table header, such as 'weight' before (kg) or 'Rate' before (mL/h). Also seen on an opening bracket right before a unit.

modes.label: Dose formula quantity
modes.description: The quantity name or opening bracket right before a unit in a calculation formula.
modes.example: Total dose (mg) = Patient's<< weight>> (kg) x 4 mg/kg

modes.label: Infusion table headers
modes.description: The last word of a column header, or the bracket after it, just before a unit like mL/h.

modes.label: Stray name and address text
modes.description: A few odd hits inside a company name or address in non-drug text.
modes.example: Council of State Governments, P.O. Box 11910,<< Lexington>>, KY 40578

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a unit label or bracketed unit next, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the label in a dosing formula or infusion table that comes right before a unit such as kg or mL/h.
